$comment: Geometry recipes (pipeline/transit_pipeline/past.py): the South Pacific Coast off today's track, from OpenHistoricalMap's ways (ohm.py), checked on the USGS sheets.

spc-alameda-west.note: OpenHistoricalMap's way, traced from the 1895 San Francisco sheet, cut where it leaves the mole line and where it reaches Central Avenue

spc-alameda-newark.note: OpenHistoricalMap's ways, traced from the 1895 San Francisco and 1899 Haywards sheets, cut at the end of the Central Avenue segment and at Newark, where the Dumbarton Cutoff joins it

spc-san-jose-los-gatos.note: OpenHistoricalMap's ways, cut at Los Gatos as the 1919 sheet labels it

spc-los-gatos-alma.note: OpenHistoricalMap's ways, cut at Los Gatos and at Alma as the 1919 sheet labels them

spc-alma-wrights.note: OpenHistoricalMap's ways, cut at Alma and at Wrights as the 1919 sheet labels them

spc-wrights-county-line.note: OpenHistoricalMap's ways, Wrights Tunnel among them

spc-newark-junctions.note: OpenHistoricalMap's way, traced from the 1899 Haywards sheet, from the Dumbarton Cutoff's junction to where today's line to Centerville leaves it
